name: Agent Tree Scale
description: Agent Tree for whole organisations – a lead agent, Chiefs of Staff on several levels and their teams, folding into rollups so thousands of agents stay readable

whenToUse: Large multi-agent runs where a lead agent delegates to Chiefs of Staff, who delegate to more chiefs and to teams of agents
Seeing at a glance which branch is running, which one waits for you and what each branch costs
Jumping straight to the agents that need a decision
whenNotToUse: A handful of agents – use Agent Tree
When things happened, in time order – use Agent Lanes

name: Role Change
description: A change to the database made visible before and while it is applied – who gains, keeps or loses access, the plan as a task list, and an undo window

whenToUse: Showing a change to user roles or access before it is written to the database
Letting someone approve a data change while the plan runs step by step
Keeping an undo window after the change is applied
whenNotToUse: Editing many fields of many records – use Data Table
A plan with no data change – use Agent Plan

props.name: title
props.description: What changes, e.g. the app's access roles

props.name: target
props.description: The table or app the change touches

props.name: rows
props.description: id, name, email, role before and after

props.name: steps
props.description: The plan shown in the project card

props.name: doneBefore
props.description: Steps already done before the decision

props.name: onApply
props.description: Writes the change; reject to show the error

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the change is dropped
